title: Law to require a plan for recycling e-bike batteries
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to create a plan for the proper disposal of rechargeable batteries used in motorized bikes, scooters and similar devices. The plan must include at least two borough-wide collection sites open seven days a week, battery collection at disposal events, voluntary in-store collection partnerships with businesses and a public education campaign. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
